description: Demo-oriented NVIDIA Dynamo dashboard: inference golden signals, Dynamo serving internals (KV router, batching/saturation, KV-cache, prefill/decode), error rate, GPU telemetry correlated to worker pods, and Kubernetes cluster/node health.

panels.description: Frontend request throughput (requests/s) served by the Dynamo frontend for the selected deployment.
panels.title: Frontend RPS

panels.description: Fraction of frontend requests with status=error (errors/total). green=0, orange>=1%, red>=5%.

targets.expr: sum(max without (job, instance) (rate(dynamo_frontend_requests_total{status="error",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"(${deployment:regex})-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) / clamp_min(sum(max without (job, instance) (rate(dynamo_frontend_requests_total{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"(${deployment:regex})-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"}[$__rate_interval]))), 1e-9)

panels.title: Error Rate

panels.description: 95th-percentile time-to-first-token at the Dynamo frontend. p95 (not mean) because tail latency drives perceived responsiveness.
panels.title: TTFT p95

panels.description: 95th-percentile inter-token latency (time between streamed tokens) at the frontend.
panels.title: ITL p95

panels.description: SGLang engine radix prefix-cache hit rate across the deployment's workers (sglang:cache_hit_rate). Higher = more prompt reuse, less recompute.
panels.title: KV Cache Hit Rate

panels.description: Average GPU utilization of THIS deployment's SGLang workers (DCGM, pod-mapped). NOTE: orange below 50% flags under-utilization (cost/efficiency), not a fault — for memory-bound decode, check GPU Memory-Bandwidth Util too.
panels.title: GPU Util Avg

panels.description: Requests currently running on the SGLang workers (sum of sglang:num_running_reqs). Batch ceiling is max-running-requests=8 per worker.
panels.title: In-flight Requests

panels.description: Requests queued in the SGLang workers waiting for a batch slot (sglang:num_queue_reqs). >0 sustained = saturation.
panels.title: Waiting Requests

panels.description: Requests queued at the Dynamo frontend/router before dispatch (dynamo_frontend_queued_requests).
panels.title: Queued at Frontend

panels.description: Highest GPU KV-cache occupancy across workers (sglang:token_usage). Near 100% triggers retractions.
panels.title: Max KV-Cache Used

panels.description: Generation token throughput (tokens/s) across the SGLang workers (rate of sglang:generation_tokens_total). SGLang exposes no stable preemption/retraction counter.
panels.title: Generation Token Rate

panels.description: Total power draw of the GPUs allocated to this Dynamo deployment's SGLang workers (DCGM, pod-mapped via exported_pod). Scoped to the selected namespace/deployment.
panels.title: Dynamo GPU Power

panels.description: Max concurrent requests per worker (SGLang --max-running-requests). The batch ceiling; In-flight/Waiting are read against this.
panels.title: Max Running Requests

panels.description: Max prefill tokens per chunk (SGLang --chunked-prefill-size).
panels.title: Chunked Prefill Size

panels.description: Model max context length (tokens).
panels.title: Context Length

panels.description: Total KV-cache blocks the engine allocated in HBM.
panels.title: Total KV Blocks

panels.description: Tokens per KV-cache block.
panels.title: KV Block Size

panels.description: Count of SGLang worker pods currently reporting metrics for this deployment.
panels.title: SGLang Workers

panels.description: Frontend request rate broken down by request_type (stream/unary) and status (success/error).

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, deployment, request_type, status) (max without (job, instance) (label_replace(rate(dynamo_frontend_requests_total{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"(${deployment:regex})-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"}[$__rate_interval]), "deployment", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[0-9]+-frontend-.*")))

panels.title: Frontend Request Rate

panels.description: Frontend latency percentiles: p95 and p99 TTFT/ITL plus mean end-to-end request duration. Watch the p95->p99 gap widen under load.

targets.expr: 1000 * histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, namespace, deployment) (max without (job, instance) (label_replace(rate(dynamo_frontend_time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"(${deployment:regex})-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"}[$__rate_interval]), "deployment", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"))))

1000 * histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, namespace, deployment) (max without (job, instance) (label_replace(rate(dynamo_frontend_inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"(${deployment:regex})-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"}[$__rate_interval]), "deployment", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"))))

1000 * sum by (namespace, deployment) (max without (job, instance) (label_replace(rate(dynamo_frontend_request_duration_seconds_sum{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"(${deployment:regex})-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"}[$__rate_interval]), "deployment", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"))) / clamp_min(sum by (namespace, deployment) (max without (job, instance) (label_replace(rate(dynamo_frontend_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"(${deployment:regex})-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"}[$__rate_interval]), "deployment", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"))), 1e-9)

1000 * histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, namespace, deployment) (max without (job, instance) (label_replace(rate(dynamo_frontend_time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"(${deployment:regex})-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"}[$__rate_interval]), "deployment", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"))))

1000 * histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, namespace, deployment) (max without (job, instance) (label_replace(rate(dynamo_frontend_inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"(${deployment:regex})-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"}[$__rate_interval]), "deployment", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"))))

panels.title: Frontend Latency

panels.description: Share of frontend requests failing (status=error), overall and by request_type. Pairs with the Error Rate stat; flat at 0 = healthy.

targets.expr: sum(max without (job, instance) (rate(dynamo_frontend_requests_total{status="error",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"(${deployment:regex})-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) / clamp_min(sum(max without (job, instance) (rate(dynamo_frontend_requests_total{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"(${deployment:regex})-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"}[$__rate_interval]))), 1e-9)

sum by (request_type) (max without (job, instance) (rate(dynamo_frontend_requests_total{status="error",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"(${deployment:regex})-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) / clamp_min(sum by (request_type) (max without (job, instance) (rate(dynamo_frontend_requests_total{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"(${deployment:regex})-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"}[$__rate_interval]))), 1e-9)

panels.title: Frontend Error Ratio

panels.description: Input vs output token throughput (tokens/s) measured at the frontend.
panels.title: Token Throughput

panels.description: Mean input and output sequence length (tokens) per request.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, deployment) (max without (job, instance) (label_replace(rate(dynamo_frontend_input_sequence_tokens_sum{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"(${deployment:regex})-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"}[$__rate_interval]), "deployment", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"))) / clamp_min(sum by (namespace, deployment) (max without (job, instance) (label_replace(rate(dynamo_frontend_input_sequence_tokens_count{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"(${deployment:regex})-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"}[$__rate_interval]), "deployment", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"))), 1e-9)

sum by (namespace, deployment) (max without (job, instance) (label_replace(rate(dynamo_frontend_output_sequence_tokens_sum{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"(${deployment:regex})-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"}[$__rate_interval]), "deployment", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"))) / clamp_min(sum by (namespace, deployment) (max without (job, instance) (label_replace(rate(dynamo_frontend_output_sequence_tokens_count{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"(${deployment:regex})-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"}[$__rate_interval]), "deployment", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"))), 1e-9)

panels.title: Average Sequence Length

panels.description: SGLang worker generate-endpoint request rate (component-level).
panels.title: SGLang Generate Request Rate

panels.description: Generate request/response payload throughput (bytes/s) between frontend and workers.
panels.title: Generate Payload Throughput
Dynamo Serving Internals — KV Router & Saturation

panels.description: Running vs waiting requests per SGLang worker. The dashed red line at 8 is max-running-requests (the per-worker batch ceiling); waiting climbing above 0 means requests are queueing for a slot.
panels.title: In-flight vs Waiting (per worker)

panels.description: GPU KV-cache occupancy per worker (sglang:token_usage). Approaching the red line risks retractions and recompute. Driven up by long contexts and concurrency.
panels.title: KV-Cache Utilization (per worker)

panels.description: Per-worker p95 time-to-first-token (ms) from the SGLang scheduler. Rising TTFT is the classic overload signature (SGLang exposes no stable preemption/retraction counter).

targets.expr: 1000 * histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, pod) (max without (job, instance) (rate(sglang:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"(${deployment:regex})-[0-9]+-sglangworker-.*"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Time To First Token p95

panels.description: Mean cache-hit fraction the Dynamo KV router measured per routed request (dynamo_component_router_kv_hit_rate). This is the router's own view that drives worker selection — distinct from the engine-side prefix-cache rate.

targets.expr: sum(max without (job, instance) (rate(dynamo_component_router_kv_hit_rate_sum{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"(${deployment:regex})-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) / clamp_min(sum(max without (job, instance) (rate(dynamo_component_router_kv_hit_rate_count{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"(${deployment:regex})-[0-9]+-frontend-.*"}[$__rate_interval]))), 1e-9)

panels.title: KV Router Hit Rate

panels.description: Per-worker load the KV router balances on: active decode KV blocks (left) and queued prefill tokens (right). Aggregated by worker_type because worker_id churns across restarts.
panels.title: Router-tracked Worker Load

panels.description: Prompt (prefill) tokens processed by the SGLang workers (tokens/s, sglang:prompt_tokens_total). SGLang exposes no separate recomputed-token counter, so cached-vs-recomputed cannot be split out here; see the Radix-Cache Hit Rate panel for prefix reuse.
panels.title: Prefill Token Rate

panels.description: SGLang radix prefix-cache hit rate (sglang:cache_hit_rate). SGLang serves a vision-language model but exposes no separate multimodal embedding-cache metric, so this tracks radix prefix-cache reuse instead. Higher = more prompt reuse, less recompute.
panels.title: Radix-Cache Hit Rate

panels.description: Per-request prefill vs decode time (p95, ms). In this aggregated deployment both phases share the same GPUs; the split shows where latency is spent.
panels.title: Prefill vs Decode Time p95

panels.description: GPU utilization attributed to THIS deployment's SGLang worker pods via DCGM Kubernetes pod-mapping (exported_pod/exported_namespace). This is the link between raw GPU telemetry and the Dynamo workload on Kubernetes.
panels.title: GPU Utilization by Dynamo Worker

panels.description: HBM used as a fraction of capacity (FB_USED/(FB_USED+FB_FREE)) for the workers' GPUs. With --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85, expect a high steady plateau (weights + KV cache).
panels.title: GPU Memory Used % by Dynamo Worker

panels.description: Cluster-wide GPU utilization by host/GPU (all DCGM-monitored GPUs, filtered by the GPU template vars).
panels.title: GPU Utilization

panels.description: GPU framebuffer (HBM) memory used per GPU, cluster-wide.
panels.title: GPU Framebuffer Memory Used

panels.description: Per-GPU power draw, cluster-wide.
panels.title: GPU Power Consumption

panels.description: Per-GPU temperature. Thresholds: orange >=75C, red >=85C.
panels.title: GPU Temperature

panels.description: DCGM MEM_COPY_UTIL for the workers' GPUs. LLM decode is memory-bandwidth bound, so this is often a better saturation signal than SM/GPU util.
panels.title: GPU Memory-Bandwidth Util (workers)

panels.description: Per-GPU SM (streaming-multiprocessor) clock.
panels.title: GPU SM Clock

panels.description: Kubernetes nodes reporting Ready.
panels.title: Ready Nodes

panels.description: Nodes NOT Ready (red if any).
panels.title: Not Ready Nodes

panels.description: Dynamo pods (frontend/sglangworker/modelexpress) in Running phase for the selected deployment.
panels.title: Dynamo Pods Running

panels.description: Dynamo pods needing attention (Pending/Failed/Unknown).
panels.title: Dynamo Pods Attention

panels.description: Cluster CPU headroom (1 - used/total).
panels.title: Cluster CPU Available

panels.description: Cluster memory headroom (MemAvailable/MemTotal).
panels.title: Cluster Memory Available

panels.description: Cumulative container restarts for the deployment's pods. Any upward step means a container crashed (OOM, liveness failure, panic).
panels.title: Dynamo Container Restarts

panels.description: Containers stuck waiting (CrashLoopBackOff/ImagePull*/CreateContainerError) or terminated abnormally (OOMKilled/Error). Shows 'No data' when everything is healthy; a line at value 1 appears to pinpoint the failing pod and reason. The 'Dynamo Pods Attention' stat above is the at-a-glance count.
panels.title: Pods in Bad State (CrashLoop / OOM / ImagePull)

panels.description: Time the SGLang workers took to load model weights (served from the ModelExpress cache). Spikes on a cold cache; flat once warm.
panels.title: Worker Model Load Time

panels.description: Dynamo pod phase distribution for the selected deployment.
panels.title: Dynamo Pod Phase

panels.description: Per-node memory available fraction.
panels.title: Node Memory Available

panels.description: Per-node root filesystem available fraction.
panels.title: Root Storage Available

panels.description: Per-node physical NIC throughput (receive shown negative).
panels.title: Node Network Throughput
